# LegalCorp SaaS - Terms of Service

## Section 1: Definitions

"Service" refers to the LegalCorp document management platform, including all web-based tools, APIs, and mobile applications provided by LegalCorp Inc.

"User" means any individual or entity that accesses the Service through a registered account.

"Subscription Period" means the duration for which the User has paid for access to the Service, which may be monthly or annual.

"Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by either party, including but not limited to business plans, technical data, trade secrets, and customer lists.

## Section 2: Account Terms

Users must be at least 18 years of age to create an account. By creating an account, you represent that you are at least 18 years old and that the information you provide is accurate and complete.

Each User is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their account credentials. LegalCorp is not liable for any loss or damage arising from unauthorized access to your account due to your failure to safeguard your credentials.

Account sharing between multiple individuals is prohibited unless the account is designated as a team account under the Enterprise plan.

## Section 3: Payment and Billing

The Service is available under three pricing tiers: Basic ($29/month), Professional ($79/month), and Enterprise (custom pricing). All prices are in US dollars and exclude applicable taxes.

Billing occurs at the start of each Subscription Period. For annual subscriptions, a 15% discount is applied to the total yearly cost. Refunds are not provided for partial months of service.

If payment fails, LegalCorp will attempt to charge the payment method on file up to three times over a seven-day period. If all attempts fail, the account will be downgraded to a read-only state until payment is resolved.

## Section 4: Data Privacy and Security

LegalCorp implements industry-standard encryption (AES-256) for data at rest and TLS 1.3 for data in transit. All data is stored in SOC 2 Type II certified data centers located in the United States.

Users retain full ownership of all data uploaded to the Service. LegalCorp does not access, use, or share User data except as necessary to provide the Service or as required by law.

Users may request a complete export of their data at any time through the account settings page. Data exports are provided in JSON format within 48 hours of the request.

## Section 5: Termination

Either party may terminate the agreement by providing 30 days written notice. Upon termination, the User's data will be retained for 90 days, after which it will be permanently deleted.

LegalCorp reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms of Service without prior notice. Grounds for immediate termination include: uploading malicious content, attempting to breach security measures, or using the Service for illegal purposes.
